name: pro-core
description: Core dev skills: brainstorming, TDD, debug, planning, worktrees, subagent-driven dev, grill-me (interview-driven plan stress-test). /gh universal GitHub workflow command (briefing, new, commit, push, pr, ship, sync, resolve).
